content.text: Rıfkı (also known as Turkish King) is a compendium trick-taking game for four players, widely played in Turkey. It is the Turkish variation of King (Barbu). Twenty hands are played; each player declares five contracts (two trump, three negative). Rıfkı refers to the King of Heartsâ€”which scores -320 to the player who wins it in that contract.
Derived from the French game Barbu (The Bearded Man, referring to the King of Hearts). It was adapted in Turkey with specific scoring weights that emphasize the penalty of the King of Hearts (Rıfkı).
Dealer shuffles; player opposite cuts. Deal all 52 cards counter-clockwise (13 each). First declarer is the holder of the Two of Diamonds; positions rotate counter-clockwise for 20 hands.
